definitions.explanation: A rough, masculine way to say 'to eat.' More casual and direct than 食べる.

definitions.gloss: to make a living, to survive
definitions.explanation: To earn enough to live on.
For insects or animals to bite.

examples.japanese: {腹|はら}{減|へ}った、{何|なに}か{食|く}おう。
{飯|めし}を{食|く}う{時間|じかん}もない。
examples.english: I don't even have time to eat.

examples.japanese: {俺|おれ}は{朝|あさ}から{何|なに}も{食|く}ってない。
examples.english: I haven't eaten anything since morning.

examples.japanese: あいつはいつも{一人|ひとり}で{飯|めし}を{食|く}っているが、{今日|きょう}は{友達|ともだち}と{一緒|いっしょ}らしい。
examples.english: He always eats alone, but today he seems to be with a friend.

examples.japanese: これで{食|く}っていける。
examples.english: I can make a living with this.

examples.japanese: {絵|え}を{描|か}いて{食|く}っている。
examples.english: I make a living by drawing.

examples.japanese: {好|す}きなことで{食|く}っていきたい。
examples.english: I want to make a living doing what I love.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}だけでは{食|く}っていけない。
examples.english: I can't make a living with just this job.

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}で{食|く}っていくのは{難|むずか}しいと{言|い}われたが、{諦|あきら}めなかった。
examples.english: I was told it's hard to make a living with music, but I didn't give up.
I was bitten by a mosquito.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}に{食|く}われそうになった。
examples.english: I almost got bitten by a dog.

examples.japanese: {虫|むし}に{食|く}われて、{足|あし}がかゆい。
examples.english: My leg is itchy because I was bitten by a bug.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}になると、{蚊|か}に{食|く}われることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: When summer comes, I often get bitten by mosquitoes.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}でキャンプをした{時|とき}、ブヨに{食|く}われて{大変|たいへん}だった。
examples.english: When I camped in the mountains, I had a terrible time being bitten by black flies.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{食|く}う.

{食|く}う is a rougher, more masculine way to say 'eat.'

REGISTER:
- Very casual, masculine speech
- Can sound vulgar in polite situations
- Often used by men, especially older generations

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {飯|めし}を{食|く}う (to eat a meal)
- {食|く}っていく (to make a living)
- 〜に{食|く}われる (to be bitten by ~)

COMPARISON:
- {食|た}べる: to eat (neutral, polite)
- {食|く}う: to eat (vulgar, masculine)
- {召|め}し{上|あ}がる: to eat (honorific)
